headline: Chelsea are 4th, Spurs 16th — and the market agrees
summary: Chelsea are 4th in the Premier League on 13 points; Tottenham are 16th on 6. Spurs did win on Monday, 3-1 against Coventry, but that came with only 0.9 expected goals, and Saturday takes them to Stamford Bridge. James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski are back, according to Yahoo Sports, yet Porro, Savio and Bergvall are still out. The market has Chelsea's win chance rising from 52.5% to 54.9%, while Spurs are given 22.5%. The handicap rates Chelsea about 0.73 goals stronger.
read: Chelsea are clear favourites for the London derby at 54.9% to Spurs' 22.5%, with the table — fourth against 16th — and a run of four straight Premier League wins over Tottenham behind the gap. The market also expects an open game at around three goals, and the one thing pulling against Chelsea is Spurs' returning creativity: Maddison and Kulusevski are back, but Porro, Savio and Bergvall are not.

facts.fact: Chelsea are clear favourites for the London derby at 54.9% to Tottenham's 22.5%.
facts.meaning: The market makes Chelsea more than twice as likely as Spurs to win at Stamford Bridge — favourites, not a formality.

facts.fact: Chelsea are fourth in the Premier League on 13 points from seven games; Tottenham are 16th on six, with a goal difference of -4.
facts.meaning: This is a derby between a top-four side and a bottom-half one, and that gap is what the price is built on.

facts.fact: The market's fair handicap line has moved from -0.63 to -0.73, with the main line at Chelsea -0.75.
Tottenham won their first Premier League game of the season on Monday, 3-1 at home to Coventry, with Maddison, Marmoush and Ben Davies scoring.
facts.meaning: Spurs arrive at Stamford Bridge off a win rather than in a crisis — the pressure has eased a little.

facts.fact: James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski both returned from injury and featured in Monday's 3-1 win.
facts.meaning: Spurs' two main creators are available for the derby, which is exactly what they lacked in their winless start.

facts.fact: Pedro Porro, Savio and Lucas Bergvall are on Tottenham's injury and suspension list for the Chelsea match.
facts.meaning: Spurs' right side and midfield rotation are stretched for a game where they will spend long spells defending.

facts.fact: Chelsea have won their last two league games, 5-1 at home to Bournemouth and 2-0 away at Everton.
facts.meaning: They come into the derby on their best run of the season, and the Everton win was built on 1.47 xG to 0.43 against.

facts.fact: Chelsea have had seven days since their last match; Tottenham played on Monday, five days before the derby.
facts.meaning: Chelsea are the fresher side for a Saturday evening kick-off at the Bridge.

sources.fact: Tottenham claimed their first Premier League win of the season by beating Coventry City 3-1, with James Maddison, Omar Marmoush and Ben Davies scoring.
James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski both returned from injury and featured in Tottenham's 3-1 win over Coventry City.
Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi said after the Coventry win that his side must keep their feet on the ground because the performance was good but they can get better.
Roberto De Zerbi confirmed that two Tottenham players will be available for Saturday's derby at Chelsea despite injury scares, though Spurs have an extensive injury list.
Sports Mole reports that Tottenham's injury and suspension list ahead of the Chelsea match includes Pedro Porro, Savio and Lucas Bergvall, with return dates listed.
Dejan Kulusevski said he had warned his closest family that his return to football might not work out before he came back from injury against Coventry.
Chelsea won 2-0 away at Everton in the Premier League in their most recent match.
Xabi Alonso is Chelsea's head coach and made one change to the starting XI for the Premier League fixture away to Everton.
